preconditions.description: The array size n and number of queries m are at least 1.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 100000 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The initial array a has exactly n elements, each between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all((1 <= l <= r <= n and 1 <= k <= 100000) if q_type == 1 else (1 <= p <= n and 1 <= x <= 100000) for q_type, l, r, k, p, x in queries_parsed)
preconditions.description: All queries satisfy the specified bounds: for type 1, 1 <= l <= r <= n and 1 <= k <= 10^5; for type 2, 1 <= p <= n and 1 <= x <= 10^5.
There is at least one query of type 1.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == sum(1 for q_type, _, _, _, _, _ in queries_parsed if q_type == 1)
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 1 queries.

postconditions.expression: all((int(line) == -1) or (int(line) >= 0) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all((int(output_lines[i]) == -1) == (len([c for x, c in freqs.items() if c > 0]) < k) for i, (q_type, l, r, k, _, _) in enumerate(queries_parsed) if q_type == 1)
postconditions.description: For each type 1 query, the output is -1 if and only if the number of distinct integers in the subarray a[l..r] is less than k.

postconditions.expression: all((int(output_lines[i]) == -1) or (min_diff_valid(freqs, k) == int(output_lines[i])) for i, (q_type, l, r, k, _, _) in enumerate(queries_parsed) if q_type == 1)
postconditions.description: For each type 1 query where a solution exists, the output is the minimum dif such that there exist k distinct integers in a[l..r] with positive counts where the absolute difference between any two counts is at most dif.
